$Comment: The Eternal Candle, the Horseman's rarest prize: while its owner carries it anywhere in the bag, storage or hotbar, the Gravekeeper lets them open the normal graveyard for their party without burning a Grave Candle, and they keep it. Hallows_Eve_Graveyard.json under ZiggfreedCommon/Dungeons names it in its EntryCost Keys (the hard graveyard does not, so the hard ride still takes a Burning Grave Candle). It drops only from the Horseman's Hoard: a roll in Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase.json and Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase_Hard.json under ZiggfreedCommon/Lootables/HallowsEvePack, so change its odds there. Old Jack buys a spare back for Hallow Sweets (ShopEntries/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Offer_Sell_Eternal_Candle.json). A plain item that only sits in the bag: no BlockType, so it can never be placed, and no recipe. It wears the game's own Wind Temple candle (its model, texture and icon), a lit candle on a teal and gold stand, so it reads apart from the two dark Grave Candles with no art of its own; Legendary quality frames it as the prize, and the faint Light is its glow in the hand or on the ground. MaxStack 1 keeps each one in its own slot; DropOnDeath false keeps it in the bag when its owner falls.
